title: Pratik Bali İngilizcesi
goalTr: Restoran, ulaşım, aktivite, konaklama ve sorunlar — hepsi kibar ve doğal kalıplarla, tek günde.

chunks.en: Could we get a table for two?

chunks.use: without peanuts / without ice / without chili.

chunks.en: How much would it be to Canggu?
chunks.use: 'would it be' pazarlık öncesi kibar soru.

chunks.en: Could you drop me off here?
How much is it per person?
Do we need to book in advance?
I think there's been a mistake.

chunks.use: 'isn't working' = bozuk/çalışmıyor kalıbı — her şeye uyar.

quick.sample: Hmm, what's popular? I like chicken and seafood.
Not really — maybe ten minutes by scooter.

quick.q: How much is it per person?
quick.sample: It says 300k per person, including lunch.

quick.q: Do we need to book in advance?
quick.sample: Probably, yeah. It gets busy at sunset.

quick.q: What time does the tour start?
quick.sample: At nine, but they pick us up at eight thirty.
Yes — and can we split it, please?
Yeah, until ten thirty, by the pool.

quick.q: How long does it take to Uluwatu?
quick.sample: About an hour, depending on traffic.
I hope so — I don't have much cash on me.

quick.q: Could I get this without ice?
quick.sample: Sure — actually, could I also get extra lime?

samples: Hmm, I think there's been a mistake — we only ordered two dishes.
Could we check the bill? That seems a bit high.

social.stmt: The sunrise tour starts at 4 AM.
samples: 4 AM? That's early! Is it worth it?
Okay — do they pick us up from the hotel?

social.stmt: Sorry, the kitchen is closing in ten minutes.
samples: No problem — could we order quickly then? Two nasi gorengs?
Ah okay — is there anywhere still open nearby?

social.stmt: This warung is famous for its babi guling.
samples: What would you recommend for someone who doesn't eat pork?

social.stmt: You can rent a board just over there.
samples: Nice — how much is it per hour?

social.stmt: There's a great sunset spot near here.
samples: Oh nice! Is it far from here? Maybe we could walk.

social.stmt: The waterfall tour includes lunch and entrance fees.
samples: Sounds good! How much is it per person? And what time does it start?

grammar.title: Kibar istekler: Could I / Could we / Would you mind

intro.ex: Could I get this without ice? (kendim için)
Could we get the bill? (grup için)
Could you drop me off here? (karşıdan istek)
Would you mind taking a photo of us? (+ -ing)

drills.best: Could I get this without peanuts?
Could you drop me off here?
Would you mind taking a photo of us?

listening.audio: Could you drop me off just past the bridge?

scenario.title: Arkadaşlarla Akşam Yemeği
scenario.situationTr: Yeni arkadaşlarınla warungda akşam yemeği. Hem garsonla ilgilen (sipariş, alerji, hesap) hem masadaki sohbete katıl.
scenario.goalTr: İki işi aynı anda yürüt: kibar isteklerle sipariş yönet + arkadaşlarla doğal sohbet.

beats.ai: ({waiter}, the waiter) Good evening! Table for how many?
beats.tr: ({waiter}, garson) İyi akşamlar! Kaç kişilik masa?
beats.sample: Good evening! Could we get a table for three?

beats.ai: ({name}) This place looks great. Have you eaten here before?
beats.tr: ({name}) Burası harika görünüyor. Daha önce burada yedin mi?
beats.sample: No, first time! But I've heard good things about it.

beats.ai: ({waiter}) Are you ready to order? Our special today is {dish}.
beats.tr: ({waiter}) Sipariş vermeye hazır mısınız? Bugünün spesiyali {dish}.
beats.sample: What would you recommend? And is it spicy?

beats.ai: ({waiter}) A little spicy. I can make it mild if you like.
beats.tr: ({waiter}) Biraz acılı. İsterseniz az acılı yapabilirim.
beats.sample: Yes please — and could I get it without peanuts? I'm allergic.

beats.ai: ({waiter}) No problem at all. And to drink?
beats.sample: A young coconut, please. Guys, what are you having?

beats.ai: ({name}) Same for me! So — how was your day? What did you get up to?
beats.tr: ({name}) Bana da aynısından! Ee — günün nasıldı? Neler yaptın?
beats.sample: Really good! I ended up at a waterfall. Totally worth it.

beats.ai: ({name}) Nice! We should all do a tour together before you leave.
beats.tr: ({name}) Güzel! Sen gitmeden hep beraber bir tur yapmalıyız.
beats.sample: I'm down! Do we need to book in advance?

beats.ai: ({name}) Probably. I'll check tonight and text you. Oh, the food's here!
beats.tr: ({name}) Muhtemelen. Bu akşam bakıp yazarım. Oo, yemekler geldi!

beats.sample: Delicious, thank you! Could we get the bill? And can we split it?
Card for me, please. Thanks so much!
